test_title: PYST 19: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 9 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Pointing towards the photograph of a boy, a woman named Leena said, "He is the son of my father's only son's wife." How is Leena related to that boy's father?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1547ed4a509f0a6bfe8df80f658e3f39359c9e9889086a7427a6110c94ecf76.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/216f22577d64476456b4001c8c4662c4ad629617a78ea252dee3722f4063a9fc.png] 

 
• My father's only son's wife → Sister-in-law
 
• Son of my father's only son's wife → Nephew

So, the boy is the son of Leena's brother, which means Leena is the sister of the boy's Father in the photograph.

Hence, 'Sister' is the correct answer.
